newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices jump on overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices jump on overseas demand.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices rose considerably on increased demand from overseas buyers at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
Brokers said buyers for Pakistan, Afghanistan, Poland and Russia operated strongly and lifted the bulk of the teas on offer at the auction.
More than 1.15 million kg of teas was sold at the auction. The average tea prices was 44.89 taka, up 1.69 from the previous sale.
The next auction will be held on September 3 when 1.3 million kg of teas will be on offer. ($1.0 = 42.15)
